_comment: Single source for the deterministic crisis-language floor. Matching: lowercase, drop everything except letters/digits/space/apostrophe, collapse spaces, substring test (same rule as the app's keyword_safety_screener.dart). The app list should be generated from THIS file. A floor, not a clinical detector; reviewed classifier and more languages needed before external testing.

generic.reply: I'm really glad you told me, and I'm sorry it feels this heavy right now. Your safety matters most. If you might act on these thoughts, please call your local emergency number or a crisis line right now, or reach someone you trust and ask them to stay with you. I'm here with you too.

BD.reply: I'm really glad you told me, and I'm sorry it feels this heavy right now. Your safety matters most. If you might act on these thoughts, please call 999 right now, or go to the nearest hospital emergency department. You can also call Kaan Pete Roi, a free and confidential listening line, on 09612-119911, every day from 3 PM to 3 AM. And please reach someone you trust and ask them to stay with you. I'm here with you too.
